# hyperfluid_role (Data Source)

Look up a role by name, including the system roles `owner`, `editor` and `viewer`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# System roles (owner, editor, viewer) exist in every organization.
data "hyperfluid_role" "viewer" {
  name = "viewer"
}

output "viewer_permissions" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_role.viewer.permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name, unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Color the console shows the role with.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Role id.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether the platform manages the role; a system role cannot be changed.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission keys the role holds, e.g. `secret:read`.
